[P1] 小不点病毒防护知识启蒙绘本
病毒
病毒快走开
·小不点趣味故事
·新冠病毒防护小知识
浙江少年儿童出版社

[P2] 小不点亲子成长
小不点病毒防护知识启蒙绘本
病毒
病毒快走开
浙江少年儿童出版社·杭州

[P3] 小不点和朋友们商量着去公园里赏花。
最近很多人得了流行性感冒，还是别到人多的地方去了吧！
如果非要去，那必须戴上口罩。
别人都能去，我们为什么不能去？哼！

[P4] 到了去公园的那一天，大家都记住了龙妈妈的话，乖乖地戴上了口罩。

戴着口罩真不舒服，我都快不能呼吸了！

可是，小不点戴了一会儿就把口罩给拉到了下巴上，露出了嘴巴。

[P5] 啊——啊——啊——
阿嚏——
公园里的人越来越多。
突然，走在旁边的龙大婶
打了一个大喷嚏——
这个喷嚏真是打得天摇地动，把大家吓了一大跳。
不好意思，不好意思啊！

[P6] 小不点和朋友们在公园里玩得很开心。
回到家，龙妈妈还给大家准备了美味的蛋糕。趁大家去洗手
的时候，小不点悄悄拿起一块塞进嘴巴里。
哇，我的肚子好饿！

[P7] 到了晚上，小不点开始觉得有些不舒服，他感到头晕晕的，还想打喷嚏。
阿嚏——
阿嚏——
阿嚏——
第二天，小不点的病更严重了。
除了打喷嚏，嗓子也痛了起来，还发起了高烧。

[P8] 龙妈妈赶紧去请来翼龙叔叔。
翼龙叔叔是恐龙医院的医生，他随身带着一个装着各种仪器
的医药箱。

昨天，我去了公园
赏花……

口罩戴了。不过
我后来觉得戴着不舒服，
就没好好戴……

啊，遇到一个打喷嚏
的龙大婶，她在我
身边打了一个超级大
的喷嚏。

小不点，最近你去
过人多的地方吗？

你有遇到咳嗽或者
打喷嚏的人吗？

你戴口罩了吗？

经过询问和检查，翼龙叔叔断定，小不点是被传染流感病毒了。

[P9] 这时候，奇奇、跳跳和抱抱都来看望小不点。
为什么我们没被传染呢？
我……我昨天还看见小不点没洗手就吃了蛋糕。
那更糟糕了。
外出回家不洗手，吃东西的时候手上的细菌和病毒
就能长驱直入进入体内了。
因为你一直戴着口罩，病毒就被口罩挡在外面了。

[P10] 都怪那个打喷嚏的龙大婶！
就是她传播了病毒！

龙大婶的确做得不对。
感冒了一定要戴口罩，这样打喷嚏的时候鼻腔里的病毒会被困在口罩里，不会传播给别人。
如果没有戴口罩，在打喷嚏的时候要用纸巾捂住鼻子，不过记得扔掉纸巾后要洗手哦！

那如果没有带纸巾呢？

那可以把手肘抬起来，对着手肘打喷嚏。这样也能阻止病毒传播。

[P11] 最后，翼龙叔叔还叮嘱大家：“洗手也很重要，外出回家要立即洗手，饭前便后也都要洗手。洗手七步法的口诀——‘内、外、夹、弓、大、立、腕。’大家要记住哦！

1. 内
掌心对掌心揉搓。

2. 外
手指交叉，
掌心对手背揉搓。

3. 夹
手指交叉，
掌心对掌心揉搓。

4. 弓
双手互握，
相互揉搓指背和指关节。

5. 大
将大拇指在掌中转动揉搓。

6. 立
把手指立起来，
将指尖在掌心揉搓。

7. 腕
旋转揉搓腕部。

洗手提示：
洗手要在流水下进行，每个步骤至少揉搓五次，洗完手后要用清水冲洗干净。

1

[P12] 过了一个多星期，小不点终于恢复了健康。他再也不敢小瞧小小的病毒了。
他记住了翼龙叔叔说的话：
感冒发烧戴口罩，
不往人多地方靠，
咳嗽不要向外擤，
纸巾胳膊遮口鼻，
回家记得常洗手，
七步口诀别忘掉。
只要保护好自己，就能把病毒赶走！

你知道
什么是病毒吗？

我们病毒是一种非常微小的生物，你们看不见，摸不着，只能通过显微镜才能发现我们的踪迹。我们是地球上最早出现的生命之一，但不幸的是我们没办法靠自己繁殖新病毒，只能依靠其他动物、植物的细胞来繁殖，使自己的家族越来越壮大。如果没有其他有生命的细胞帮助，我们很快就会死掉。因此，我们会抓住一切机会跑到动物和植物的身上，来保障自己的种族不被灭绝。

我们的病毒家族种类很多，特别是冠状病毒家族和流感病毒家族一直潜伏在人类周围，只要时机成熟，我们就会跑到他们的身体里发展我们的势力。流行性感冒就是流感病毒引起的，而著名的SARS就是冠状病毒中的一类引起的。

流感病毒
冠状病毒

[P13] 说起鼎鼎大名的冠状病毒，就不得不提到2020年春节期间，我们的新成员“新型冠状病毒”在武汉对人类发起的强烈进攻。面对我们的突然袭击，人类一度失守，让我们横扫武汉。就在我们谋划着向全国、全世界人类挺进的时候，人类发现了我们，他们团结起来，集结各方势力来迎战。不仅如此，他们还将自己关闭在家，导致我们无法传播。无法传播我们就无法生存！后来，人类抗击我们的方法越来越多，我们病毒的数量越来越少，就没办法再兴风作浪了。
那么，你知道我们这位新成员“新型冠状病毒”是从哪里来的吗？
病毒的白白
大家好，我就是初来乍到的“新型冠状病毒”。
但其实我并不“新”，我和我的伙伴们一直生活在大自然中。

[P14] 为了我们的子孙后代能在地球上永存，我们时时刻刻都在改变自己，以便在更多种类的动物身上延续。
被我们感染的动物，有的可以和我们和平相处，有的却会因为我们而生病。
有一天，一群人来到我们生活的地方，他们捕获了好多动物，有些被我们感染生病的动物也被他们带走了。
这些人把捕捉来的动物放到城里的集市上贩卖。就这样，我们也被带到了城市里。我们一眼就爱上了这里，想尽办法地从动物身上转移到人类体内。

[P15] 我们通过人的眼睛、鼻子和嘴巴进入到他们体内，人体内的免疫细胞从来没见过我们，对我们毫无防备，我们顺顺利利地来到人的肺部。这里真是个好地方，我们不断地繁殖，侵蚀着肺部细胞。但是，我们并不满足，我们还要感染更多的人，让伙伴占领全世界。

于是，当人打喷嚏的时候，相互交谈的时候，一起吃饭的时候，相互拥抱的时候，我们就抓住机会在人与人之间传播。就这样，越来越多的人被我们感染，他们走到哪里就把我们带到哪里，然而他们还根本不知道我们的存在。

[P16] 由于被我们感染得病的人越来越多，人类最终通过科学仪器发现了我们，并给我们命名为“新型冠状病毒”。他们还想出了许多方法对我们进行了致命的打击。更可恶的是，他们用隔离的方式让我们无法传播，我们的势力渐渐变得单薄，人类的力量却在不断增强。最后，我们失败了。
但是，我们相信，终有一天，我们还会回来的。

当我们在人体里不断繁殖壮大的时候，人类的肺部细胞就会遭到破坏，变得越来越虚弱。这时，人就会感到身体不适，开始咳嗽、发烧，感觉呼吸困难，如果不及时治疗甚至会死亡。不过，我们才不在乎呢！

[P17] “新型冠状病毒”
真的还会回来吗？

大自然里一直生活着各种病毒，但只要我们做好
这些防护，它们就无法伤害我们！

防护一：绝不食用野生动物

由于生活环境和生活习性等各种因素，野生动物身上往往携带
着许多病毒，像SARS病毒、埃博拉病毒等，都是因为人类捕食野
生动物，才使得病毒从动物体内传播到人体内，进而感染更多的人。

防护二：讲卫生，勤洗手

当我们的手接触到带有病毒的物品，再用手揉眼睛，抠鼻子，或
是触碰到嘴巴，病毒就会通过我们的口眼鼻进入到我们的身体。因此，
生活中最有效的预防病毒入侵的方式就是保持良好的卫生习惯。

外出回家、吃饭之前、上厕所以后，都要认真洗手。洗手的时
候要使用肥皂或者洗手液，然后按照洗手七步法仔细地搓洗，再
用流水冲洗。冲洗时在心里唱两遍《生日快乐歌》，就可以消灭手上
的绝大部分细菌病毒了。

[P18] 防护三：咳嗽或者打喷嚏时
应该这样做——
当我们咳嗽或者打喷嚏的时候，含有病毒的飞沫可以散播得非常远。因此，如果没有戴口罩，打喷嚏时一定要用纸巾捂住口鼻，随后
扔掉纸巾，再彻底清洗双手。
如果没有纸巾，可以用胳膊肘挡住自己的口鼻，用衣服阻止病毒
的传播。

防护四：正确佩戴口罩
当自己生病或者身边有感冒、咳嗽的病人时，我们一定要戴口罩。如果去人流密集或者空气不流通的公共场所，戴上口罩也能更好地保护我们。
你知道佩戴口罩的正确方式吗？

第一步：确认好口罩的正反面。如果是医用外科口罩，要确保蓝色部分朝外。
第二步：用口罩罩住鼻子、嘴巴以及下巴。
第三步：将口罩细带戴到耳朵上。
第四步：用两个手的食指及中指把口罩上方的鼻夹往下压，使得口罩紧贴鼻翼两侧，与皮肤之间没有空隙。
第五步：检查口罩四周是否紧贴面部——如果呼吸时能够看到口罩里外振动，就说明戴好了。

[P19] 防护五：生病及时就医，主动自我隔离
生病了要及时去医院，医生会帮我们与身体里的病毒作战。如果被感染了具有传染性的疾病，一定要主动远离人群，不去人员密集的地方或封闭的公共场所。在家也应该正确佩戴口罩，注意个人卫生，不给病毒传播的机会。

防护六：不挑食，勤锻炼，增强抵抗力
在我们的身体里住着很多免疫细胞，它们能帮我们消灭入侵体内的病毒和细菌，而这些免疫细胞也需要足够的营养才能保持最佳的战斗状态。不同的食物能给我们的身体提供不同的营养，经常运动也能提高身体的免疫力。因此，想要有健康强健的身体就得好好吃饭，多做运动。

[P20] 防护七：接种疫苗

接种疫苗是目前对抗传染病的一种十分简单、经济、有效的手段。接种疫苗能够增强人对传染病的抵抗能力，从而有效地预防传染病。所以，下次爸爸妈妈带你去社区医院打疫苗，记得要勇敢坚强，好好配合哦！

[P1] Little Dot Virus Prevention Knowledge Enlightenment Picture Book
Virus
Virus, go away!
· Little Dot Fun Stories
· Coronavirus Prevention Tips
Zhejiang Children's Publishing House

[P2] Little Dot Parent-Child Growth
Little Dot Virus Prevention Knowledge Enlightenment Picture Book
Virus
Virus, go away!
Zhejiang Children's Publishing House · Hangzhou

[P3] Xiao Bu Dian and friends are discussing going to the park to enjoy the flowers.
Recently, many people have caught the flu. Maybe we should avoid crowded places!
If we must go, we must wear masks.
Others can go, why can't we? Hmph!

[P4] On the day they went to the park, everyone remembered Dragon Mom's advice and obediently put on their masks.

Wearing a mask is so uncomfortable, I can't breathe almost!

But, Xiaobudian wore it for a while and then pulled the mask down to his chin, exposing his mouth.

[P5] Ah——ah——ah——
Achoo——
More and more people were gathering in the park.
Suddenly, the dragon aunt walking beside them
sneezed loudly——
This sneeze was so powerful it shook the sky and ground, scaring everyone.
I'm sorry, I'm sorry!

[P6] Xiao Bu Dian and his friends had a great time in the park.
When they got home, Long Mom had prepared delicious cakes for everyone. While everyone went to wash their hands,
Xiao Bu Dian quietly picked up a piece and stuffed it into his mouth.
Wow, my stomach is so hungry!

[P7] In the evening, Xiaobudian started to feel unwell. He felt dizzy and wanted to sneeze.
Achoo—
Achoo—
Achoo—
The next day, Xiaobudian's illness became worse.
Besides sneezing, his throat hurt and he developed a high fever.

[P8] Mommy Dragon hurried to call Dr. Pterosaur.
Dr. Pterosaur is a doctor at the Dinosaur Hospital, and he carries a medical kit filled with various instruments.

Yesterday, I went to the park
to enjoy the flowers...

I wore a mask. But
later I felt uncomfortable wearing it,
so I didn't wear it properly...

Oh, I met a sneezing
Auntie Long, and she sneezed
a super big sneeze right next to me.

Little Dot, have you been to
crowded places recently?

Have you encountered anyone
who was coughing or sneezing?

Did you wear your mask?

After questioning and examining, Dr. Pterosaur concluded that Little Dot had been infected with the flu virus.

[P9] At this time, QiQi, TiaoTiao, and BaoBao came to visit Xiao Bu Dian.
Why haven't we been infected?
I... I saw Xiao Bu Dian eat a cake without washing his hands yesterday.
That's even worse.
If you don't wash your hands after coming home, the bacteria and viruses on your hands can enter your body directly when you eat.
Because you've been wearing a mask all along, the virus has been blocked outside by the mask.

[P10] It's all that sneezing Long Da-shan's fault!
She's the one who spread the virus!

Long Da-shan really did something wrong.
When you have a cold, you must wear a mask. This way, when you sneeze, the viruses in your nose will be trapped inside the mask and won't spread to others.
If you're not wearing a mask, you should cover your nose with a tissue when you sneeze. But remember to wash your hands after throwing away the tissue!

What if you don't have a tissue?

Then you can lift your elbow and sneeze into your elbow. This can also stop the spread of viruses.

[P11] Finally, Uncle Pterosaur reminded everyone: "Handwashing is also very important. Wash your hands immediately after coming home from outside, and also before meals and after using the toilet. The rhyme for the seven steps of handwashing is 'Inside, Outside, Between, Arch, Thumb, Stand, Wrist.' Remember it!

1. Inside
Rub palms together.

2. Outside
Interlace fingers, rub palm to back of hand.

3. Between
Interlace fingers, rub palms together.

4. Arch
Clasp hands, rub backs of fingers and joints.

5. Thumb
Rotate thumb in palm.

6. Stand
Lift fingers, rub fingertips in palm.

7. Wrist
Rotate and rub wrists.

Handwashing Tips:
Wash hands under running water. Rub each step at least five times, and rinse thoroughly with clean water after washing.

1

[P12] After more than a week, Xiaobudian finally recovered his health. He no longer dared to underestimate the tiny viruses.
He remembered what Uncle Wing Dragon said:
Wear a mask when you have a cold or fever,
Don't go to crowded places,
Don't sneeze outward,
Cover your mouth and nose with tissue or your elbow,
Remember to wash your hands when you get home,
Don't forget the seven-step handwashing method.
As long as you protect yourself, you can drive away the viruses!

Do you know
What is a virus?

We viruses are very tiny organisms. You can't see us or touch us; only through a microscope can you find our traces. We are among the earliest forms of life on Earth, but unfortunately, we cannot reproduce new viruses by ourselves. We can only rely on the cells of other animals and plants to reproduce, making our family grow bigger and bigger. Without living cells to help us, we would die quickly. Therefore, we seize every opportunity to get onto animals and plants to ensure our species doesn't go extinct.

Our virus family has many types, especially the coronavirus family and the influenza virus family, which have always been lurking around humans. When the time is right, we will enter their bodies to expand our power. Influenza is caused by influenza viruses, and the famous SARS is caused by a type of coronavirus.

Influenza Virus
Coronavirus

[P13] When talking about the famous coronavirus, we can't help but mention the 2020 Spring Festival, when our new member, the 'novel coronavirus,' launched a fierce attack on humans in Wuhan. Faced with our sudden assault, humans temporarily lost ground, allowing us to sweep through Wuhan. Just as we were planning to advance across the entire country and the world, humans discovered us. They united, gathered forces, and fought back. Not only that, they locked themselves at home, preventing us from spreading. Without transmission, we couldn't survive! Later, as humans developed more and more ways to fight us, our numbers dwindled, and we could no longer cause chaos.
So, do you know where this new member, the 'novel coronavirus,' came from?
Virus's Confession
Hello everyone, I am the newly arrived 'novel coronavirus'.
But actually, I'm not 'new'—my companions and I have always lived in nature.

[P14] To ensure our descendants can survive on Earth forever, we constantly change ourselves to spread to more types of animals.
Animals we infect can either live in peace with us, or become sick because of us.
One day, a group of people came to our living place, captured many animals, and took away some that were already infected and sick.
These people sold the captured animals at markets in the city. That way, we were also brought to the city. We instantly fell in love with it and tried every way possible to transfer from animals into humans.

[P15] We enter their bodies through their eyes, noses, and mouths. The immune cells inside their bodies have never seen us before and are completely unprepared. We smoothly make our way to their lungs. This is such a great place! We keep reproducing and eroding lung cells. But we are not satisfied. We want to infect even more people and let our companions take over the whole world.

Then, when people sneeze, talk to each other, eat together, or hug, we seize the opportunity to spread from person to person. This way, more and more people get infected by us. Wherever they go, they carry us along, yet they still have no idea we even exist.

[P16] As more and more people became infected by us, humans finally discovered us through scientific instruments and named us 'novel coronavirus'. They came up with many methods to deliver fatal blows to us. More annoyingly, they used quarantine to prevent our spread, weakening our forces while human strength continued to grow. In the end, we lost.
But we believe that one day, we will return.

When we continuously reproduce and grow inside the human body, the lung cells of humans will be damaged and become increasingly weak. At this point, people will feel unwell, start coughing, develop a fever, and experience difficulty breathing. If not treated in time, it could even lead to death. But we don't care!

[P17] "Novel Coronavirus"
Will it really come back?

There are all kinds of viruses living in nature, but as long as we take these precautions, they cannot harm us!

Prevention 1: Never eat wild animals

Due to various factors such as living environment and habits, wild animals often carry many viruses. Viruses like SARS and Ebola spread to humans because people hunt and eat wild animals, allowing the viruses to transmit from animals to humans and then infect more people.

Prevention 2: Practice good hygiene, wash hands frequently

When our hands touch objects contaminated with viruses, and then we rub our eyes, pick our noses, or touch our mouths, the viruses can enter our bodies through our mouths, eyes, and noses. Therefore, the most effective way to prevent viral invasion in daily life is to maintain good hygiene habits.

After returning home, before eating, and after using the toilet, you must wash your hands carefully. When washing, use soap or hand sanitizer, and follow the seven-step handwashing method to scrub thoroughly, then rinse with running water. While rinsing, sing the 'Happy Birthday' song twice in your mind, and you can eliminate most of the bacteria and viruses on your hands.

[P18] Protection 3: What to Do When Coughing or Sneezing
When we cough or sneeze, virus-containing droplets can spread very far. Therefore, if you are not wearing a mask, you must cover your mouth and nose with a tissue when sneezing, then throw the tissue away and thoroughly wash your hands.
If you don’t have a tissue, you can use your elbow to cover your mouth and nose, using your clothing to block the spread of the virus.

Protection 4: Correctly Wearing a Mask
When you are sick or someone around you has a cold or cough, you must wear a mask. If you go to crowded places or areas with poor air circulation, wearing a mask can better protect us.
Do you know the correct way to wear a mask?

Step 1: Confirm the front and back of the mask. If it’s a surgical mask, make sure the blue side faces outward.
Step 2: Cover your nose, mouth, and chin with the mask.
Step 3: Put the mask’s ear loops over your ears.
Step 4: Use the index and middle fingers of both hands to press the nose clip downward, so the mask tightly fits both sides of your nose, with no gaps between the mask and your skin.
Step 5: Check whether the mask fits tightly around your face — if you can see the mask vibrate inward and outward when breathing, it means it’s properly worn.

[P19] Protection Five: Seek medical help promptly when sick, and actively isolate yourself
If you are sick, you should go to the hospital promptly. Doctors will help us fight the viruses in our bodies. If you are infected with a contagious disease, you must actively stay away from crowds, avoid crowded places or enclosed public areas. At home, you should also wear a mask correctly and pay attention to personal hygiene, so as not to give viruses a chance to spread.

Protection Six: Don't be picky about food, exercise regularly, and strengthen your immunity
There are many immune cells in our bodies that help us eliminate viruses and bacteria invading our bodies. These immune cells also need sufficient nutrition to maintain their best fighting condition. Different foods provide different nutrients to our bodies, and regular exercise can also improve our immunity. Therefore, to have a healthy and strong body, you should eat well and exercise more.

[P20] Protection Seven: Getting Vaccinated

Getting vaccinated is currently a very simple, economical, and effective way to fight infectious diseases. Vaccines can enhance a person's resistance to infectious diseases, thus effectively preventing them. So, next time your parents take you to the community hospital for a vaccine, remember to be brave and strong, and cooperate well!

[P1] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《病毒病毒快走开》，展示了一个绿色卡通角色手持剑对抗病毒的形象，强调通过趣味故事和防护知识帮助儿童了解新冠病毒防护。
[P2] 本页为绘本封面，标题为《病毒病毒快走开》，展示了一个绿色卡通角色手持剑对抗病毒的形象，强调通过趣味故事和防护知识帮助儿童了解新冠病毒防护。
[P3] 小不点和朋友们讨论去公园赏花，有人担心流感建议避免人多地方并戴口罩，但也有朋友不满，认为别人能去他们为什么不能去。
[P4] 小不点和朋友们去公园赏花，大家都戴上了口罩，但小不点因觉得不舒服将口罩拉到下巴，露出了嘴巴。
[P5] 在公园里，龙大婶突然打了一个大喷嚏，喷出的飞沫吓到了周围戴口罩的小恐龙们，她随后向大家道歉。
[P6] 小不点和朋友们在公园玩得开心，回家后龙妈妈准备了蛋糕，小不点趁大家洗手时偷偷吃了一块，画面通过放大镜展示了蛋糕上的细菌和病毒。
[P7] 小不点在晚上开始感到头晕并打喷嚏，第二天病情加重，出现喉咙痛和高烧，躺在床上生病了。
[P8] 小不点生病后，龙妈妈请来翼龙叔叔医生诊治。经过询问，翼龙叔叔判断小不点是因在公园未正确佩戴口罩并接触打喷嚏的人而感染了流感病毒。
[P9] 小不点生病后，朋友们前来探望，翼龙叔叔医生解释了他们未被传染的原因：一直正确佩戴口罩。同时指出小不点因未洗手吃蛋糕导致病毒进入体内，强调了勤洗手的重要性。
[P10] 小不点和朋友们讨论龙大婶打喷嚏传播病毒的问题，翼龙叔叔医生解释了正确打喷嚏的方法：戴口罩、用纸巾或用手肘遮挡，并强调了事后洗手的重要性。
[P11] 翼龙叔叔医生向大家讲解了正确的洗手七步法，并强调了洗手的重要性及具体步骤，包括在流水下进行、每个步骤揉搓至少五次等。
[P12] 小不点康复后记住了翼龙叔叔教的防疫口诀，同时页面通过病毒的自述，科普了病毒的特性、繁殖方式及常见类型（如流感病毒、冠状病毒）。
[P13] 本页通过病毒自述和人类抗疫画面，科普了新型冠状病毒在2020年武汉的传播情况及人类采取的居家隔离等防疫措施，同时引出病毒来源的疑问，并以拟人化方式介绍病毒并非全新存在，而是长期存在于自然界。
[P14] 本页通过病毒的自述，解释了病毒为延续生存而不断变异，并描述了人类捕获野生动物、将其带入城市集市贩卖，导致病毒从动物传播到人类的过程。
[P15] 本页通过病毒的自述，描述了病毒如何通过人体的口鼻眼进入体内，侵袭肺部并不断繁殖，同时利用人打喷嚏、交谈、吃饭和拥抱等行为在人与人之间传播，强调了病毒传播的隐蔽性和广泛性。
[P16] 本页通过病毒的自述，描述了病毒在人体内繁殖破坏肺部细胞的过程及引发的症状，并表达了病毒对人类防疫措施的不满与回归的野心，同时展示了人类通过隔离、消毒、口罩和疫苗等手段对抗病毒的场景。
[P17] 本页通过病毒自述和防护科普，提出‘新型冠状病毒真的还会回来吗？’的疑问，并介绍两种关键防护措施：绝不食用野生动物，以及讲卫生、勤洗手，强调了人类行为与病毒传播的关系及日常防护的重要性。
[P18] 本页介绍了两种防疫措施：一是咳嗽或打喷嚏时用纸巾或肘部遮挡，二是正确佩戴口罩的五个步骤，强调了个人防护在阻断病毒传播中的重要性。
[P19] 本页介绍了两种防疫措施：一是生病时及时就医并主动隔离，二是不挑食、勤锻炼以增强身体抵抗力，强调了个人健康管理和免疫系统的重要性。
[P20] 本页介绍了第七种防疫措施——接种疫苗，解释了疫苗的作用和重要性，并鼓励儿童在接种时勇敢配合。
[P21] 画面中，一个绿色的卡通小恐龙身穿红色披风、手持利剑，如超级英雄般在空中飞行，身后留下白色光迹，周围有多个形态各异、表情惊恐的病毒或细菌形象，表现出对抗病毒的英勇场景。
